findings.message: The collection is exposed but no permissive policy grants read, so nobody can read it
Anyone, including anon, may insert, delete any document
The claim user_metadata.owner can be edited by the user, so it must not drive authorization
The using regex /(a)\1/ needs backtracking and cannot run in process
The using clause doubles as the update check, so an update may not move a document out of it
No token issuer emits the role editor
No index starts with owner, which this policy filters on for every query
No index starts with wrong, which this policy filters on for every query
where names the field wrong, which no sampled document of notes has
fields.read.editor.omit names the field typo, which no sampled document of notes has
immutable names the field locked, which no sampled document of notes has
fields.read has rules for editor but no default, so every other role can access all fields
The context lookup groups has no max
